title: Structural Engineer or Draftsperson
abstract: Design and deliver diverse structural projects in a supportive Bendigo team, with opportunities to grow your skills and work across exciting projects.
location: Bendigo, Bendigo, Goldfields & Macedon Ranges VIC
screening_questions: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
What's your expected annual base salary?
How many years' experience do you have as a structural engineer?
How much notice are you required to give your current employer?
Have you completed a qualification in civil engineering?
content_text:
About the role
Join our team at SGP Consulting Engineers as our new Structural Engineer or Draftsperson. This full-time position is based in Bendigo, VIC, where you'll play a key role in designing and delivering structural engineering projects for our clients. This exciting opportunity will give you plenty of exposure to a wide variety of interesting and challenging projects.
What you'll be doing
- Preparing detailed structural engineering designs, including calculations, drawings, and specifications for commercial and residential projects
- Design and detailing for reinforced concrete works in precast and pre-stressed concrete
- Collaborating with project managers, architects, building designers, councils, contractors, fabricators and other stakeholders to ensure designs meet requirements
- Producing high-quality technical documentation and reports
- Staying up-to-date with relevant engineering standards, regulations, and best practice
What we're looking for
- Solid experience and proficiency in CAD is essential, and qualifications will be highly regarded
- Tertiary qualification in Civil or Structural Engineering is preferred but not required.
- Experience in a similar role, preferably within the building/civil/structural engineering industry
- Our office currently uses AutoCAD 2017 and Civil 3D
- Strong technical design and problem-solving skills
- Exceptional attention to detail and a commitment to "right first time" philosophy
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team
- Demonstrated ability to work efficiently to meet customer time expectations, manage priorities and deliver under pressure
- Knowledge of relevant Australian Standards and building codes
What we offer
We offer competitive remuneration and ongoing professional development opportunities in our close-knit team. Whether you're just starting out, building your career or looking for a lifestyle move, we'd love to hear from you. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis; early submission is encouraged.
About us
SGP provides a wide variety of structural and civil engineering services to the building, industrial, commercial and government sectors. We're based in Bendigo and work across Victoria and southern NSW. We undertake an extensive range of projects across multiple sectors with varying levels of complexity. Every project is a new challenge, and you'll love learning and applying your skills in this fast-paced environment.
